# Wildcard Voices

> Wildcard Voices is Worcester’s friendliest, most bonkers music community: a no-audition community choir in Worcester, UK, plus 1-1 singing lessons across the Midlands and online, and singing and acting workshops for schools. It was founded and is led by Cerys, a professional actor, singer and singing teacher. Slogan: “Your voice. Our mixtape.”

Key facts:

- Based in Worcester, UK. In-person lessons and school workshops across the Midlands. Online lessons anywhere in the UK.
- Everyone is welcome, whatever their gender, orientation, ability or background. The choir is for adults aged 18 and over; 1-1 lessons and school workshops are open to younger singers. No auditions, no sheet music (everything is taught by ear) and no singing experience needed.
- Enquiries: use the contact form at https://wildcardvoices.co.uk/contact. Choir terms, concessions and drop-ins can be booked and paid for online from the choir page.

## Community choir

- [Wildcard Choir](https://wildcardvoices.co.uk/choir): weekly community choir in Worcester for adults aged 18 and over, 7:30 to 9:30pm. Each term is a new “mixtape” of pop bangers through the eras, building to an end-of-term concert with the chance to sing with a live band. Missed weeks get a practice track.
- Prices: first session free; 4-week term £45; concession £35 (students and over 60s); drop-in £15.
- Next free first session: Thursday 3 December 2026, 7:30 to 9:30pm, at Elgar School of Music.
- Venue: Elgar School of Music, 16-20 Deansway, Worcester WR1 2ES (map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/gwi5YMAYz2HfM1nU8). Step-free access. Nearby car parks include Copenhagen Street (WR1 2EY), CrownGate (WR1 3LX), Newport Street (WR1 3NG) and Cathedral Square, College Street (WR1 2LU).
- Wildcard Junior, a choir for younger singers, is coming soon, with a waiting list open now.

## 1-1 singing lessons

- [Singing lessons](https://wildcardvoices.co.uk/lessons): private lessons for adults, teens and children, from complete beginners to seasoned performers, in person across the Midlands (including at Elgar School of Music in Worcester) or online by live video.
- Prices: 60 minutes £45 in person or £40 online; 30 minutes £35 in person or £30 online.
- Covers pop and rock, musical theatre, audition preparation, drama school and music school entry, breathing and technique, and performance confidence.

## Schools and workshops

- [Workshops for schools](https://wildcardvoices.co.uk/schools): singing and acting workshops for schools, drama schools and youth groups across the Midlands. Options include Perform Like a Pro sessions, half-term singing days, Christmas assembly singing, A Christmas Carol acting workshops, and combined singing and acting workshops. Prices depend on group size and length; contact for a quote.

## Gift vouchers

- [Gift vouchers](https://wildcardvoices.co.uk/gifts): choir gift (4-week term) £45; Wildcard combo (4-week term plus one 1-1 lesson) £85; one 60-minute lesson £45 in person or £40 online; three lessons £130; or any amount from £20. Vouchers arrive by email and are valid for 12 months.

## About

- [About Wildcard Voices](https://wildcardvoices.co.uk/about): Cerys trained in Musical Theatre at the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland, has acted and sung professionally (including A Christmas Carol and Alice in Wonderland), appeared in the Schwarzkopf Live 2026 campaign, and has over 10 years of teaching experience across the Midlands, currently at Elgar School of Music and The Elms School. Cerys is DBS checked and an Equity member.

## Contact

- [Contact form](https://wildcardvoices.co.uk/contact): book a free choir session or ask about lessons, workshops or gift vouchers.
